decision_timing: Follow-up hypothesis after the frozen held-out graph results; fixed before any adaptation outcome is evaluated
motivation: Frozen source-only transfer can lose accuracy under typed-owner graph and class-distribution shifts; test whether retained source parameters can initialize target-local SSL
stage_one: Source-only SSL for source-to-target condition; target-only SSL for repeated-target control. No labels. Fixed original base learning rate 0.0008, at most 600 epochs, minimum 60, patience 40, minimum training-loss checkpoint.
stage_two: Reset the same encoder seed, initialize a new target-local model, copy only target-type input projection and retained meta-path encoder from stage one, reinitialize every auxiliary identity projection, NG, SM, and contrastive projector; fresh Adam; at most 600 epochs with the same rate and stopping rule. Target graph labels are excluded.
parameter_audit: Transferred retained-parameter hashes equal stage-one hashes; all other parameter hashes equal an independently seeded target-only initialization; audit restores RNG states before training
positives: Same v3 graph-local fixed normalized meta-path union ranking, at most eight nonself plus self; no new generator mode selected from results
evaluation: After both phases, freeze the retained encoder. Use exactly the v3 target probe split, five probes, and one validation-cross-entropy-selected checkpoint for all metrics.
comparisons: Report all source-to-target adaptation results relative to the original target-only reference. For full TriView-HCL, also compare a target-to-target two-stage control with the same phase budgets and auxiliary restart.
cost_scope: Additional first-stage graph access and training cost are explicit; single-stage target-only reference is not a matched-total-compute baseline, while repeated-target full control tests the effect of additional SSL phases
prohibited: No learning-rate grid, graph-split retry, test-dependent checkpoint, selective seed reporting, or replacement of the earlier frozen result table
